national_reconciliation.description: Sustain the promised stability through reconciliation. More peaceful civic activity may include voices opposing the government.

fiscal_recovery.description: Reduce debt relative to GDP and restore payment credibility. Slower construction helps finance the adjustment.

peace_dividend.description: Remain at peace for a meaningful part of the term and at its end. Recovery benefits, but offensive military strength is reduced.

institutional_renewal.description: Sustain stronger institutions and the promised stability. Additional credit capacity comes with an administrative cost.

shared_prosperity.description: Sustain a higher living standard. Output improves, but expansion becomes more expensive to finance.
